prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original song cover for a cute piano-learning app Library. Make an edge-to-edge wide 3:2 image, ideally 1536×1024. Mandatory visual style: PREMIUM 2D HAND-DRAWN CARTOON PICTURE-BOOK ILLUSTRATION. Chunky rounded character shapes, clear warm dark-brown outlines, simple flat cel-shaded colors, only a little matte paper texture. Large expressive dot eyes, pink cheeks, tiny paws, cute soft proportions. The character style should feel like a sophisticated app's miniature animal companions. NOT a realistic painting, NOT a photograph, NOT 3D, NOT plastic, NO fine oil-paint detail. Clear strong silhouettes and a simple scene that reads at thumbnail size. Keep all focal characters complete, fully inside the central70% of the canvas; preserve important subjects in moderate3:2-to-16:10 crops. No letters, no musical notation, no logos, no signature, no text, no border, no watermark.
Distinct story: a sleepy chubby bunny is curled safely inside a crescent-shaped little boat on a perfectly still midnight lake. The boat sits at the quiet center; three simple silvery ripples spread gently beneath it. Soft indigo, lilac, and silver bedtime palette; rounded distant shore shapes and a few simple stars. The bunny has relaxed closed curved eyes, pink cheeks, tucked tiny paws and clear long soft ears. Intimate quiet, ample space around the complete crescent boat; no dramatic waves.
semanticDescription: A sleepy bunny curls inside a crescent boat on a still indigo lake with three silver ripple rings.
qualityReview: Passed: complete crescent boat and bunny, simple sleepy expression, three visible ripple rings, calm indigo/lilac contrast. Clearly cartoon rather than realistic; no visible text/signature.
